[[Gruhn the Fisher]] is a fisherman who catches herrings. According to [[Nicholas the Traveler|Nicholas Sandford]], she creates floats from the Bog Skale Fins she collects.{{#tag:ref|[[Nicholas_the_Traveler/Dialogue#Kryta|Dialogue]] from his first cycle's visit to [[Scoundrel's Rise]].}}
